definitions.explanation: Describes a person, event, or circumstance that is favored by good fortune.

examples.japanese: {幸運|こううん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{幸運|こううん}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幸運|こううん}なことだった。
examples.english: Surviving that accident was truly fortunate.

notes:
Composed of {幸|こう} (happiness, fortune) + ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧ (luck, fate). Can be used as a na-adjective ({幸運|こううん}な), as a noun (⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧), or adverbially ({幸運|こううん}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧). The adverbial form {幸運|こううん}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (fortunately) is extremely common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幸運|こううん}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: fortunately, luckily
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to wish someone good luck
- {幸運|こううん}に⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with good fortune
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧: a lucky person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ラッキー→ラッキー：11254_rakkii⟧: lucky — casual loanword used in everyday conversation
- ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧: fortunately, luckily — adverbial use similar to {幸運|こううん}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ but slightly more formal
- ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: lucky — a more colloquial way to say someone is lucky
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧な: unlucky, unfortunate — the antonym
